errorCodes.meaning: The DID is unknown to this VTA or unreachable by the caller.

AgentNameEntry.description: An agent name bound to a DID. A name is only ever authoritative in the DID→name direction: the DID document's `alsoKnownAs` is what proves the binding, because anyone controlling a domain can point a name at somebody else's DID.

enabled.description: Whether the name currently resolves. A disabled name is still held — it is not available for anyone else to take.

name.description: The name, without the host — the full form is `<host>/@<name>`.

AgentNameEntry.title: AgentNameEntry

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

names.description: Names held for the DID, including disabled ones — a disabled name is still held and cannot be taken by anyone else.
